suggestion.topic: Python GIL Explained: Why Multi-Threading Lies to You
suggestion.rationale: Python developers constantly hit CPU-bound performance bottlenecks and are mystified why adding threads doesn't speed up execution. Explaining the Global Interpreter Lock satisfies massive active search volume.
suggestion.hook_angle: Your multi-threaded Python code is secretly running on a single CPU core—here is why the GIL is lying to you.
